.v61-faction.v62-core{aspect-ratio:1.8/1;min-height:0!important}
.v61-faction.v62-core .v61-picture::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:38% 0 0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(1,8,5,.93),rgba(1,8,5,.30) 54%,transparent);pointer-events:none}
.v61-faction.v62-core .v61-faction-main{display:flex!important;position:absolute;z-index:2;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;min-width:0;min-height:56px;padding:14px 15px 11px;align-items:flex-end;pointer-events:none}
.v61-faction.v62-core .v61-faction-main>*:not(strong){display:none!important}
.v61-faction.v62-core .v61-faction-main strong{display:block;font:900 clamp(19px,3vw,27px)/1.12 system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#ffe5a2;text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000,0 0 2px #000;max-width:100%}

.v61-banner img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 52%}
.v61-banner::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:22%;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#07120b88,transparent);pointer-events:none}
.v61-dossier-head h2{font-size:clamp(18px,3.2vw,27px)!important;letter-spacing:.06em}
.v61-steps li b{white-space:nowrap!important;overflow-wrap:normal!important;flex:0 0 23px}
@media(max-width:700px){.v61-faction.v62-core{aspect-ratio:1.8/1!important}.v61-faction.v62-core .v61-faction-main{min-height:47px;padding:8px 11px 9px}.v61-faction.v62-core .v61-faction-main strong{font-size:clamp(17px,5vw,22px)}.v61-banner{height:clamp(145px,25vh,220px)!important}.v61-dossier-head{padding-bottom:7px!important}}
@media(max-width:390px){.v61-faction.v62-core .v61-faction-main strong{letter-spacing:.03em}}
